system.description: Grants Ritual access to the Ritualism discipline, extended to sound-based illusions — illusions only. A named extension of the universal discipline, not a second contested school. No general sound magic rides in: a voice that isn't there, a hoofbeat on the wrong street, a scream from an empty room; never a real, load-bearing sound effect.
